017package org.apache.juneau.bean.jsonschema;
018
019import static org.apache.juneau.commons.utils.AssertionUtils.*;
020import static org.apache.juneau.commons.utils.ThrowableUtils.*;
021
022import java.lang.reflect.*;
023
024import org.apache.juneau.marshall.collections.*;
025import org.apache.juneau.marshall.json.*;
026import org.apache.juneau.marshall.jsonschema.*;
027import org.apache.juneau.marshall.marshaller.Json;
028import org.apache.juneau.marshall.parser.*;
029
030/**
031 * Bridge for generating typed {@link JsonSchema} beans from Java types.
032 *
033 * <p>
034 * {@link JsonSchemaGenerator} in <c>juneau-marshall</c> produces <c>JsonMap</c> output.  This class wraps that
035 * generator and converts the generated map into typed <c>JsonSchema</c> beans in <c>juneau-bean-jsonschema</c>.
036 *
037 * <h5 class='section'>Example:</h5>
038 * <p class='bjava'>
039 *    <jc>// Default generation.</jc>
040 *    JsonSchema <jv>s1</jv> = JsonSchemaBeanGenerator.<jsf>DEFAULT</jsf>.generate(MyBean.<jk>class</jk>);
041 *
042 *    <jc>// Custom generation with bean defs and descriptions.</jc>
043 *    JsonSchema <jv>s2</jv> = JsonSchemaBeanGenerator.<jsm>create</jsm>()
044 *       .useBeanDefs()
045 *       .addDescriptionsTo(TypeCategory.<jsf>ANY</jsf>)
046 *       .build()
047 *       .generate(MyBean.<jk>class</jk>);
048 * </p>
049 */
050public final class JsonSchemaBeanGenerator {
051
052   /** Reusable default instance. */
053   public static final JsonSchemaBeanGenerator DEFAULT = create().build();
054
055   /** Creates a new builder. */
056   public static Builder create() {
057      return new Builder();
058   }
059
060   private final JsonSchemaGenerator generator;
061
062   private JsonSchemaBeanGenerator(Builder builder) {
063      this.generator = builder.generatorBuilder.build();
064   }
065
066   /**
067    * Generates a schema bean from a Java type.
068    *
069    * @param type The Java type.  Must not be <jk>null</jk>, or an {@link IllegalArgumentException} is thrown.
070    * @return The generated schema bean, or <jk>null</jk> if a schema could not be generated for the type.
071    */
072   @SuppressWarnings({
073      "java:S1452" // Self-bounded (CRTP) generic: the generated schema's concrete SELF subtype is not known here, so JsonSchema<?> is the only sound return type.
074   })
075   public JsonSchema<?> generate(Type type) {
076      assertArgNotNull("type", type);
077      try {
078         var session = generator.getSession();
079         var root = session.getSchema(type);
080         if (root == null)
081            return null;
082         var defs = session.getBeanDefs();
083         if (defs != null && ! defs.isEmpty())
084            root.append("$defs", defs);
085         return toBean(root);
086      } catch (Exception e) {
087         throw toRex(e);
088      }
089   }
090
091   /**
092    * Generates a schema bean from a Java class.
093    *
094    * @param type The Java class.  Must not be <jk>null</jk>, or an {@link IllegalArgumentException} is thrown.
095    * @return The generated schema bean, or <jk>null</jk> if a schema could not be generated for the class.
096    */
097   @SuppressWarnings({
098      "java:S1452" // Self-bounded (CRTP) generic: the generated schema's concrete SELF subtype is not known here, so JsonSchema<?> is the only sound return type.
099   })
100   public JsonSchema<?> generate(Class<?> type) {
101      return generate((Type)type);
102   }
103
104   /**
105    * Generates a schema bean from an object.
106    *
107    * <p>
108    * The value can be a POJO or a <c>Class</c>/<c>Type</c>.
109    *
110    * @param o The value to infer a schema from.  Must not be <jk>null</jk>, or an {@link IllegalArgumentException} is thrown.
111    * @return The generated schema bean, or <jk>null</jk> if a schema could not be generated for the value.
112    */
113   @SuppressWarnings({
114      "java:S1452" // Self-bounded (CRTP) generic: the generated schema's concrete SELF subtype is not known here, so JsonSchema<?> is the only sound return type.
115   })
116   public JsonSchema<?> generate(Object o) {
117      assertArgNotNull("o", o);
118      try {
119         var session = generator.getSession();
120         var root = session.getSchema(o);
121         if (root == null)
122            return null;
123         var defs = session.getBeanDefs();
124         if (defs != null && ! defs.isEmpty())
125            root.append("$defs", defs);
126         return toBean(root);
127      } catch (Exception e) {
128         throw toRex(e);
129      }
130   }
131
132   /**
133    * Converts a generated schema map into a typed bean.
134    *
135    * <p>
136    * Conversion uses a JSON roundtrip to ensure the swaps declared on {@link JsonSchema} are honored.
137    *
138    * @param schemaMap The generated schema map.  Must not be <jk>null</jk>, or an {@link IllegalArgumentException} is thrown.
139    * @return The typed schema bean.
140    */
141   @SuppressWarnings({
142      "java:S1452" // Self-bounded (CRTP) generic: the parsed schema's concrete SELF subtype is not known here, so JsonSchema<?> is the only sound return type.
143   })
144   public static JsonSchema<?> toBean(JsonMap schemaMap) {
145      assertArgNotNull("schemaMap", schemaMap);
146      try {
147         var json = Json.of(schemaMap);
148         return JsonParser.create().ignoreUnknownBeanProperties().build().read(json, JsonSchema.class);
149      } catch (ParseException e) {
150         throw toRex(e);
151      }
152   }
153
154   /** Builder for {@link JsonSchemaBeanGenerator}. */
155   public static final class Builder {
156      private final JsonSchemaGenerator.Builder generatorBuilder = JsonSchemaGenerator.create();
157
158      private Builder() {}
159
160      /** Mirrors {@link org.apache.juneau.marshall.jsonschema.JsonSchemaGenerator.Builder#addDescriptionsTo(TypeCategory...)}. */
161      public Builder addDescriptionsTo(TypeCategory...values) {
162         generatorBuilder.addDescriptionsTo(values);
163         return this;
164      }
165
166      /** Mirrors {@link org.apache.juneau.marshall.jsonschema.JsonSchemaGenerator.Builder#addExamplesTo(TypeCategory...)}. */
167      public Builder addExamplesTo(TypeCategory...values) {
168         generatorBuilder.addExamplesTo(values);
169         return this;
170      }
171
172      /** Mirrors {@link org.apache.juneau.marshall.jsonschema.JsonSchemaGenerator.Builder#allowNestedDescriptions()}. */
173      public Builder allowNestedDescriptions() {
174         generatorBuilder.allowNestedDescriptions();
175         return this;
176      }
177
178      /** Mirrors {@link org.apache.juneau.marshall.jsonschema.JsonSchemaGenerator.Builder#allowNestedDescriptions(boolean)}. */
179      public Builder allowNestedDescriptions(boolean value) {
180         generatorBuilder.allowNestedDescriptions(value);
181         return this;
182      }
183
184      /** Mirrors {@link org.apache.juneau.marshall.jsonschema.JsonSchemaGenerator.Builder#allowNestedExamples()}. */
185      public Builder allowNestedExamples() {
186         generatorBuilder.allowNestedExamples();
187         return this;
188      }
189
190      /** Mirrors {@link org.apache.juneau.marshall.jsonschema.JsonSchemaGenerator.Builder#allowNestedExamples(boolean)}. */
191      public Builder allowNestedExamples(boolean value) {
192         generatorBuilder.allowNestedExamples(value);
193         return this;
194      }
195
196      /** Mirrors {@link org.apache.juneau.marshall.jsonschema.JsonSchemaGenerator.Builder#beanDefMapper(Class)}. */
197      public Builder beanDefMapper(Class<? extends MarshallingDefMapper> value) {
198         generatorBuilder.beanDefMapper(value);
199         return this;
200      }
201
202      /** Mirrors {@link org.apache.juneau.marshall.jsonschema.JsonSchemaGenerator.Builder#ignoreTypes(String...)}. */
203      public Builder ignoreTypes(String...values) {
204         generatorBuilder.ignoreTypes(values);
205         return this;
206      }
207
208      /** Mirrors {@link org.apache.juneau.marshall.jsonschema.JsonSchemaGenerator.Builder#useBeanDefs()}. */
209      public Builder useBeanDefs() {
210         generatorBuilder.useBeanDefs();
211         return this;
212      }
213
214      /** Mirrors {@link org.apache.juneau.marshall.jsonschema.JsonSchemaGenerator.Builder#useBeanDefs(boolean)}. */
215      public Builder useBeanDefs(boolean value) {
216         generatorBuilder.useBeanDefs(value);
217         return this;
218      }
219
220      /** Builds a new generator. */
221      public JsonSchemaBeanGenerator build() {
222         return new JsonSchemaBeanGenerator(this);
223      }
224   }
225}
